agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A live-state closeout suite excludes historical equality nodes whose frozen revision and orientation are not current acceptance predicates.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first post-clockwork command included a historical test fixed at Continuity 324 and the former check-in orientation, producing two non-regression failures.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The failure text named only the old graph revision and old strategic-role assertion; the current-state suite then passed without rewriting the historical test.

correction.action: Rerun the current-state suite without the immutable historical equality node and preserve that node unchanged.
correction.prevention_control: Live closeout suites are assembled from active acceptance paths; frozen historical equality nodes require an explicit active reason before inclusion.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects inclusion of an immutable historical snapshot test in a live-state suite.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Read-only PowerShell projections use admitted statement-form control flow.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: A read-only file projection piped directly from an inline foreach construct and stopped at parsing.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: PowerShell emitted an empty-pipe parser error before any command, file or Git mutation.

correction.action: Use separate statement-form commands for the diff check and exact file readings.
correction.prevention_control: Multi-step PowerShell readings assign or emit results only after statement-form control flow completes.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records recurrence and correction of the PowerShell inline-expression parser defect.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: PowerShell Git revision expressions containing braces are quoted as one exact argument.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The unquoted commit-peel expression resolved a parent form and then passed an encoded brace fragment that Git rejected.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only command output contained the unintended parent and fatal ambiguous-argument errors; quoted revisions returned both intended full commits.

correction.action: Quote every full Git revision expression containing braces before passing it to Git.
correction.prevention_control: Manual PowerShell Git peels use one single-quoted revision argument; contract evidence uses the repository resolver instead.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects unquoted PowerShell Git commit-peel syntax.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A source-rewrite count is measured at the exact transformation stage where it is asserted.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first guard derivation required three selectedTools tokens after the signature rewrite had already consumed one and only two body references remained.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The direct source check rejected the post-rewrite count before commit or evidence generation.

correction.action: Require the two body references that remain after the signature rewrite and rerun the direct check.
correction.prevention_control: Rewrite predicates name whether their expected count is pre-transform or post-transform and retain a focused rejection test.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects a source-anchor count measured at the wrong rewrite stage.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The raw-detail guard rejects release projections without rejecting fixed internal error-message comparisons.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first predicate banned every .message read and falsely rejected three accepted equality or lookup checks that release no raw content.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The closed reading named only derived_sources_release_no_raw_detail; exact source projection showed the three fixed internal comparisons.

correction.action: Match actual detail, stack, cause, environment, prompt, response and credential projections instead of the generic message member.
correction.prevention_control: Release guards target output coordinates and preserve fixed internal classification comparisons.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects an over-broad raw-detail predicate that confused internal comparison with release.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A direct controller check returns zero only for the single admitted closed result.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first rejected derivation printed its closed result but returned exit code zero.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The orchestrator read the typed result as non-admitted despite the process status and stopped before commit or evidence generation.

correction.action: Return nonzero for every result except root_service_forwarding_correction_admitted.
correction.prevention_control: The direct CLI exit contract is derived from the same single admitted closed-result constant used by evidence acceptance.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects a rejected controller result that initially exited zero.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A deterministic evidence check resolves the implementation-owning commit identically before and after evidence descendants advance HEAD.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The preliminary reading used current HEAD, so later recomputation would select the evidence descendant rather than the implementation owner.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The pre-verifier audit compared evidence-time binding semantics with the post-evidence repository position before acceptance.

correction.action: Resolve the commit that last changed the controller path, emit immutable v2 evidence and recompute after its descendant commit.
correction.prevention_control: Implementation ownership comes from the Git path history plus repository resolver; current HEAD remains only the live worktree position.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects a time-sensitive current-HEAD candidate binding with an idempotent source-owner resolution.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The rolling Current-Baton acceptance row remains within the live handover compaction byte budget.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout intent listed every long operation artifact separately and the prospective projection exceeded the Baton compaction budget.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The governance clockwork rejected tick_baton_compaction_budget before any canonical publication.

correction.action: Collapse operation-owned artifacts to the single continuity directory and keep only controlling external artifacts explicit.
correction.prevention_control: Rolling acceptance rows name an operation directory once and reserve individual entries for controlling cross-directory documents and receipts.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects an over-dense rolling acceptance path list before canonical publication.
